commentary: With market breadth pinned at 44 and the deterministic gate flagged WEAK, legendary market-direction discipline mandates defensive risk posture. Benchmark indices trade pinned beneath their 20- and 50-day exponential moving averages, weighed down by relentless institutional foreign selling despite counter-cyclical domestic support. Weinstein Stage Analysis emphasizes that broad market headwinds compress the success rate of even sound Stage 2 breakouts. Under O'Neil and Livermore rules, this tape requires strict progressive exposure: preserve capital, avoid chasing extended moves, enforce tight 5% to 8% stop losses, and restrict consideration to true relative strength leaders demonstrating confirmed, accelerating earnings growth in resilient sectors such as capital goods and specialty chemicals.
limitations: Daily scan observations are not fills or performance results.
Price levels are scanner references, not live quotes.

analysis.analyst: Minervini SEPA, O'Neil CANSLIM, Weinstein Stage Analysis & Livermore Discipline

AAATECH.technical: Price cleared its 20-day high on an explosive 10.93x volume surge, pushing RSI to 64 with MACD turning positive above signal and zero. However, this is an early emerging base breakout rather than a confirmed Stage 2 uptrend, requiring price absorption above the 50-day moving average.
AAATECH.fundamental: AAA Technologies is an IT audit micro-cap with virtually zero debt, but return ratios remain modest (ROE 6.7%, ROCE 9.0%). Promoter holding is low at 34.4%. Revenue growth (+3.2% YoY) and net profit (+13.0% YoY) fall far short of CANSLIM high-growth standards.
AAATECH.risk: Close below trigger stop ₹91.81 invalidates the breakout; micro-cap liquidity risks heighten slippage during broad market pullbacks.

AAREYDRUGS.technical: Forming a 26.6% deep double-bottom cup with a 5.7% handle in the upper half. Price trades above EMA21, SMA50, and SMA200 with RSI at 65, but the setup struggles against heavy overhead supply and lacks institutional volume sponsorship.
AAREYDRUGS.fundamental: Active pharmaceutical ingredient trader with poor return metrics (ROE 3.1%, ROCE 5.6%) and weak interest coverage. Q1 FY27 revenue dropped 56.3% YoY while net profit declined 25.6% YoY, failing core CANSLIM baseline quality standards.
AAREYDRUGS.risk: Breakdown below handle stop ₹95.61 confirms failure; deteriorating top-line momentum and negative earnings trend risk institutional distribution.

ACE.technical: Forming a high-quality double-bottom base (12.8% depth) with a tight 4.4% handle in the upper half. Holding above EMA21, SMA50, and SMA200 with MACD momentum confirming the pivot. Displays resilient relative strength within the capital goods sector.
ACE.fundamental: Market leader commanding ~63% share in mobile cranes. High capital efficiency (ROCE 31.6%, ROE 22.8%), virtually zero debt, and 65.4% promoter holding. Revenue grew 18.9% YoY with EBITDA margins holding steady near 20% despite commodity inflation.
ACE.risk: Violation of handle stop ₹1189.87 breaks base structure; slowdown in domestic infrastructure capex would weaken equipment order execution.

ACMESOLAR.technical: Transitioning into Stage 2 from an extended post-listing base, constructing a double bottom testing the ₹477.38 neckline. Price sits above EMA21, SMA50, and SMA200 with MACD above signal and RSI at 61, demonstrating improving accumulation.
ACMESOLAR.fundamental: Major renewable IPP and battery storage operator with 3.6 GWh BESS capacity. Q1 FY27 revenue jumped 63.3% YoY while PAT surged 79.9% YoY (24.7% net margin). Substantial project debt is balanced by long-term utility PPAs.
ACMESOLAR.risk: Drop below support stop ₹436.83 breaches double-bottom pivot; project commissioning delays and capital-intensive balance sheet pose key risks.

ADVANCE.technical: Constructing a rounding saucer base recovering toward overhead resistance, sitting within 1.5% of the 20-session pivot at ₹141.64. Price trades above EMA21, SMA50, and SMA200 on expanding 1.99x volume with RSI at 57.
ADVANCE.fundamental: Agrochemical player exhibiting sharp acceleration: Q1 FY27 revenue rose 95.9% YoY while PAT jumped 152.2% YoY. Supported by sound balance-sheet health (D/E 0.31, ROE 17.2%, ROCE 19.6%) and 69.9% promoter holding, though working capital days increased.
ADVANCE.risk: Failure below pivot stop ₹130.78 terminates the near-breakout setup; elongated working capital and commodity agrochemical pricing remain primary hazards.

AETHER.technical: Textbook SEPA breakout clearing 20-day resistance to print new 52-week highs. Volume expanded 8.13x the 20-day average, signaling aggressive institutional accumulation. Trades comfortably above upward-sloping EMA21, SMA50, and SMA200 with superior relative strength.
AETHER.fundamental: Specialty chemicals leader delivering 31% EBITDA margins. Q1 FY27 PAT rose 33.5% YoY on 27.3% sales growth. High-margin CRAMS/CEM expansion (70% target mix), Dow Chemical partnership, and unpledged 74.9% promoter holding support high valuation (P/E ~98x).
AETHER.risk: Close below breakout stop ₹1596.97 invalidates SEPA thrust; elevated valuation multiple leaves no room for CRAMS order execution delays.
